hooks.command: if [ "${OPENCLINXR_WORKER:-0}" = "1" ] || [ -n "${GROK_SUBAGENT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; S=.openclinxr/openclaw/factory-pulse-last.json; if [ -f "$S" ] && [ -n "$(find "$S" -mmin +90 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "FACTORY PULSE STALE: last run $(date -r "$S" -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; fi; pnpm openclinxr:factory-pulse || true
